fixed_point_baselines.HALF_SHRINK: 0.5 previous territory share + 0.5 previous-election national share, renormalized.
fixed_point_baselines.NATIONAL_ONLY: Every territory receives the previous-election national party-share vector.
fixed_point_baselines.PERSIST: Each territory receives its previous-election party-share vector.

generator_boundary.forbidden: The forecast generator may not open the target-year canonical result.
generator_boundary.scoring: Target-year canonical result is opened only by the separate scorer after the forecast artifact exists.

interpretation_rules: These are skill-floor benchmarks, not candidate final models.
A target outcome may never be used to choose or construct that target's forecast.
2016 and 2021 are development folds, not fresh confirmatory holdouts.
No claim of calibrated probabilistic seat forecasting is allowed from this V1 point-forecast lab.
When 2007/2002 arrive, rerun as rolling-origin forecasting before freezing 2026.

metrics.uncertainty: Paired territory-cluster bootstrap for point-error differences; does not create additional election-regime replication.

north_star: Build and freeze before the 2026 election the most accurate calibrated falsifiable territorial and seat forecast supported by the data; model technology is irrelevant.
